chol.denotation: BECOME(subject,property); does not by itself assert material lineage or KindChange.

ockhdar.denotation: EXTERNAL and HEAT: two content atoms in one opaque whole, not a suffix construction.

olkar.denotation: EXCESSIVE; independent property-form synonym of sheedy, counted.

roseer.denotation: Postposed attribution of the preceding clause as the narrator argument conclusion; no independent validity guarantee.

oteey.denotation: BLOOD; positive product kind, never benefit or exclusivity.

ol.denotation: ALSO; repeated additive particles do not duplicate events or add truth conditions.

oloqorain.denotation: O: the source opposite-circumstance profile; not Boolean NOT(W), and no mixed-case precedence.

otedy.denotation: EXCESSIVE postmodifier of boiling; independent synonym, counted.

qotchdy.denotation: HIPPOCRATES, attributed source of the following advice.

chckhey.denotation: FORBID_FOOD_USE(source,recipient-profile,food-kind); ingestion is the explicit conventional action-content of this dietary-advice predicate, not a result event.

ytchedy.denotation: BILIOUS modifier of the following locative recipient expression.

qotedar.denotation: HONEY; independent exact-whole synonym of or, counted, not a morphological derivation.

qotchd.denotation: CONFIRMS(source,claim-reference): reports corroboration; not an independently verified efficacy judgment.

qotom.denotation: Nearest preceding complete advised proposition, preserving advice mode rather than converting it into a Product event.

soiis.denotation: ELDERLY; not automatically opposite-profile or cold.

chok{co}m.denotation: Refers to food-use content of the nearest explicit FORBID_FOOD_USE clause, without inheriting its recipient restriction or prohibition; this event-content extraction costs a rule.

shedor.denotation: PERSON as bodily recipient kind; overlaps BODY but is an independent lexical value.

chey.denotation: SOURCE_OF(result,origin); two declared typed realizations: condition/cause and output-material/precursor. Not a silent identity relation.

sorain.denotation: NATURE / natural constitution, independent source-nature word; no physical input or faculty meaning.

shedy.denotation: PRODUCT(case,input-kind,output-description); input and product are roles, not disjoint sorts. Same operator in singular and explicitly lifted comparison clauses.

tedy.denotation: YELLOW_BILE; independent synonym of qokal, counted.

sodaiiin.denotation: EARLIER_THAN(product-event,product-kind): compares onset of bile production to production of the next written blood kind; does not negate blood.

chy.denotation: BLOOD; independent exact-whole synonym of oteey, counted.

ytedar.denotation: Opens a second case profile in contrast to the last explicit recipient-profile case; not Boolean negation.

chz[s:r].denotation: O, the source opposite-circumstance profile, applied to a written body; not simply COLD, Boolean NOT(W), or a precedence rule. Independent whole synonym of oloqorain, with modifier use licensed explicitly.

arody.denotation: RECEIVE(recipient,portion-description), binding the case input portion.

ypshedy.denotation: Introduces one material portion x; no kind until the following OF phrase supplies it.

dar.denotation: OF_KIND(portion,material-kind), as in a portion of this honey; not PartAt(portion,abstract-kind).

chedy.denotation: Typed demonstrative identifying a written referent; forward output reference permitted only by the single declared CF scope rule.

am.denotation: YIELD: an additional independently guessed product verb, same positive relation as shedy but subordinated to explicit RECEIVE; no unique output.

qodaiin.denotation: IN(BODY): licensed qod|aiin; body owner must be the active written case recipient.

odain.denotation: BY(production,process), with both terms explicitly supplied.

an.denotation: KIND_CHANGE on the lineage supplied by the following FROM phrase and current written output; lexical change alone cannot introduce missing endpoints.

orar.denotation: PRE_EVENT relative to the active written case; not any earlier case or the generic ingredient kind.

ain.denotation: FOOD; generic edible material/container kind, not a synonym or alias of BODY.

okees.denotation: SUPPOSE opens a counterfactual claim frame, closed by the following BUT; no truth of the assumption is endorsed.

olaiin.denotation: EXISTS binds the following material-portion variable; no preformation/lineage conjunction hidden in this word.

qokal.denotation: YELLOW_BILE; one kind at both its hypothetical constituent and product positions.

chdy.denotation: PART_AT(z,input,t0); owner and time must come from separate food/time expressions.

sary.denotation: PRE_EVENT time for the hypothetical constituent; independent synonym of orar, counted.

qokshedy.denotation: NO_KIND_CHANGE on the explicit precursor/output lineage within the current hypothesis. Does not assert equal results across recipients.

qodain.denotation: IN(FOOD): licensed qod|ain; FOOD is the case input container, never BODY.

chckhy.denotation: LINEAGE(z,y,c), neither token identity nor mass conservation.

ykeedy.denotation: Introduces the output y whose relation to z is asserted; its kind must be supplied by a written Product clause.

ckhed[a:y].denotation: EVERY modifies the immediately preceding BODY class in the CF production clause; exact uncertain whole only.

olchey.denotation: RECIPIENT_INVARIANT_RESULT applied to the explicitly body-quantified production; an extra attributed bridge, not a consequence of preformation.

qokeody.denotation: BITTER and FOOD: two content atoms in one opaque class description; no qok segmentation.

qoekedy.denotation: Nearest previous explicitly named product kind in the same claim frame; here YELLOW_BILE, not the same output individual.

dody.denotation: The following explicit Product clause is parallel to the preceding one; does not copy input tokens or recipients.

los.denotation: Closes the explicit SUPPOSE frame and resumes narrator assertions in contrast with its consequent.

ar.denotation: RECIPIENT: a bodily recipient/container role-kind, not the particular S person or a property.

qokshey.denotation: DIFFERENT_RESULTS(c1,c2), requiring the separately written comparison pair; positive product names alone do not entail it.

qose?y.denotation: The two cases’ product sets, with membership tied to written Product clauses; exact uncertain whole only.

og.denotation: Postposed COMPARE_WITHIN(proposition,food-kind,recipient-kind): resolves the previously written compare-pair by kind/sort, then applies the explicitly written outcome-difference modifier.

lcheol.denotation: The current written argument as a discourse object, not a one-word assertion that generation is proven.

sheoly.denotation: CLEAR / evident: narrator appraisal of the written argument, not independent validation.

ZL_clauses.formula: Compare(c1,c2,HONEY,HONEY); each case has its own yet-to-be-bound portion and recipient.

ZL_clauses.reading: Excessive heating produces saltiness and then bitterness.
ZL_clauses.formula: GENERIC food-heating e: EXCESSIVE(e) => CAUSES(e, SALTY before BITTER).

ZL_clauses.reading: Similarly, a honey portion becomes bitter.
ZL_clauses.formula: Introduce xBoil with Kind(xBoil,HONEY); BECOME(xBoil,BITTER), under the explicitly preceding heating analogy.

ZL_clauses.reading: External heat is excessive and harmful, therefore.
ZL_clauses.formula: ExternalHeat(h); EXCESSIVE(h,xBoil) and HARMFUL(h,xBoil); narrator marks this inference.

ZL_clauses.reading: Warmth arises from constitution, age, disease, season, locality and occupation.
Blood also results under opposite circumstances.
ZL_clauses.formula: GENERIC_PRODUCT(HONEY,O,BLOOD), with the written discourse food-kind and the nominal-product construction. O is not a Boolean complement.
AFTER(BITTER_STATE,EXCESSIVE(BOILING)); not the converse diagnostic claim.

ZL_clauses.reading: Hippocrates forbids honey for use in a bilious recipient.

ZL_clauses.formula: REPORT(CONFIRMS(EXPERIENCE, precedingAdvice)); confirmation is historical report, not a Product assertion.

ZL_clauses.reading: An elderly body benefits from that use.
ZL_clauses.formula: GENERIC BENEFIT(ELDERLY(BODY), FoodUse(HONEY)) extracted from the explicitly advised food-use content, without its prohibition/recipient guard.

ZL_clauses.reading: For a person warm by nature, honey forms yellow bile earlier than blood.
ZL_clauses.formula: Case(cW,HONEY,xW,pW,W,t0W,t1W); Warm(pW) with source NATURE; Product(cW,yW,YELLOW_BILE); onset(yW)<onset(blood-product), without excluding blood. Bind first Compare case slot.

ZL_clauses.reading: Conversely, a body under opposite circumstances receives a portion of this honey, yielding blood in the body by kind change from a previous constituent of the food.
ZL_clauses.formula: Case(cC,HONEY,xC,pC,O,t0C,t1C); RECEIVE(pC,xC); Product(cC,yC,BLOOD); In(yC,pC); zC constituent of xC before event; Lineage(zC,yC,cC); KindChange(zC,yC,cC). Bind second Compare slot. No zC=yC or xW=xC is asserted.

ZL_clauses.reading: Suppose bile exists as a previous part in the food, without kind change, a precursor of this output.
ZL_clauses.formula: In SUPPOSE frame: for relevant food-case c, exists z: PartAt(z,x_c,t0_c) and Kind(z,YELLOW_BILE,t0_c) and Lineage(z,y_c,c) and NoKindChange(z,y_c,c). Output THIS resolves forward to first explicit Product y_c in the same hypothesis.

ZL_clauses.reading: For honey in every body, honey as food uniformly forms bile.
ZL_clauses.formula: Within SUPPOSE consequent: for bodies p, Case(c_p,HONEY,x_p,p,sigma_p,t0_p,t1_p); Product(c_p,y_p,YELLOW_BILE); U=recipient-invariant result. The U bridge is explicitly olchey and every-body scope ckhed[a:y], not inferred from W1.

ZL_clauses.reading: Bitter foods likewise form that product kind in the body.
ZL_clauses.formula: Within SUPPOSE consequent: generic bitter-food kind kB; fresh Case(cB,kB,xB,pB,sigmaB,t0B,t1B); Product(cB,yB,YELLOW_BILE); In(yB,pB). No honey-portion identity is inherited.

ZL_clauses.reading: But recipients form different products in the comparison of honey across bodies.
ZL_clauses.formula: Close SUPPOSE. Postposed comparison adjunct resolves Compare(cW,cC,HONEY,HONEY) and BODY recipient sort. Assert DIFFERENT_RESULTS(cW,cC) separately, using explicit qokshey + qose?y, not as a deduction from positive bile/blood labels.

ZL_clauses.reading: Also, the argument becomes clear as well.
ZL_clauses.formula: BECOME(ARGUMENT,CLEAR) with two independently contributed additive modifiers. This is an epistemic appraisal, not an additional provenance fact or proof.

countercase_alternates.effect: The opposite-profile-case blood product is located in food rather than in the body. It cannot be normalized to ZL qodaiin. This alone does not logically negate change, but it fails transfer of the specifically body-located provenance claim.
ZL initial HONEY topic becomes RECIPIENT; the later HONEY remains. The current exact ZL clause template no longer transfers without a declared alternative grammar.
Same template shift; marked ckhe and shedy alternatives also remain gaps.

new_value_costs.ordinary_dietary_advice_predicate_contai: chckhey forbids FOOD_USE, conventionally ingestion, counted as additional semantic action commitment
new_value_costs.not_compression_evidence: The 82 independent whole guesses dominate cost. Three derived qod forms and reused production/transition syntax are genuine constraints inside this guess, not evidence of a discovered morpheme.

grammar.definition: The18 authored clause spans are explicit editorial choices, totaling17 internal boundaries across108 groups. Physical line breaks are not sentence punctuation. No group is shared between spans, erased or interpreted twice. This chosen bracketing is not independently recovered.
grammar.cost: 17 boundary choices; no claim a unique parse follows from types.

grammar.definition: Unmarked clauses belong to a narrator assertion frame. HIPPOCRATES+FORBID introduces advice; EXPERIENCE+CONFIRM reports corroboration; SUPPOSE opens the CF frame; BUT closes it. THEREFORE and CLEAR report inference/appraisal, not scientific validity. The external source hypothesis tentatively compares this narrator with Galen; no written target name GALEN is supplied.
grammar.cost: 1 default narrator convention plus4 explicit mode/frame productions.

grammar.definition: COMPARE K1 K2 introduces comparison slots c1,c2 and their two recipient variables. If the written kind values coincide, their common kind becomes the discourse food-kind topic across these four blocks. BODY DIFFER applies to those recipient slots. This asserts distinct recipients, never identical portions, composition, dose or patient time series.
grammar.cost: 1 binary comparison/binder production;2 case slots;1 kind-topic scope across four blocks;1 recipient-difference application.

grammar.definition: RecipientProperty RecipientKind yields a restricted recipient description. RecipientKind FROM Cause attaches source to that property. A ConditionProfile may also modify a RecipientKind via a declared profile-to-modifier lifting; no profile is completed by a hidden age/disease precedence.
grammar.cost: 2 NP productions and1 explicit ConditionProfile modifier lift. Examples: WARM PERSON, BILIOUS IN(RECIPIENT), ELDERLY BODY, O BODY.

grammar.definition: RecipientProperty IN(RecipientKind) yields a locative expression restricted to recipients having that property. IN itself is unchanged. This accounts for BILIOUS before qodar, not an arbitrary property cast.
grammar.cost: 1 typed modifier-location production, currently exercised once.

grammar.definition: An atemporal class/condition clause binds generic case variables with separate input portion, recipient and before/after event times. It does not assert a single observed patient. A lexical honey-portion or PORTION OF THIS HONEY introduces a portion description within its own case. Class membership is not PartAt(physical,abstract-kind).
grammar.cost: 1 generic-case closure with5 role variables(c,x,p,t0,t1) per case, plus output y introduced by Product;1 portion introduction production.

grammar.definition: Kinput FORMS Koutput and Kinput [written modifiers] Koutput FORMS both produce Product(c,y,Koutput) with Kind(x,Kinput,t0). Case/recipient come from the written profile or location. Food/ProductKind are roles of MaterialKind. The first/last input-output order is fixed, not selected by English gloss desirability. A product-kind reference may occupy the output position.
grammar.cost: 2 ordered productions for the same shedy relation, not zero-cost free word order. Reused in S1,W2,W3; W4 has the separately counted plural lift.

grammar.definition: Product clause EARLIER_THAN K2 compares the onset of its product event with production of the next written kind K2 in that case. It does not assert that K2 is absent, the only later product or beneficial.
grammar.cost: 1 temporal-comparison production; one use at S1.

grammar.rule: Profile cases and the compare slots
grammar.definition: A written recipient-profile NP followed by a fully written food Product clause binds the next unfilled slot of the current comparison. CONVERSE opens the second profile case. The nominal general law E2 does not consume a slot because it has no separately written input case clause. The slots bind S1 then S2; they are not selected by line numbers.
grammar.cost: 1 sequential slot-binding rule plus1 contrast-case rule; an explicit global discourse convention.

grammar.definition: Recipient RECEIVE [PORTION OF [THIS Kind]] binds recipient p and input x; YIELD [ProductKind] then introduces y for the same case. The participle shares only its explicitly introduced reception arguments. It neither changes the input kind nor equates input and output tokens.
grammar.cost: 2 ordered productions; am is an additional whole synonym of production, not a component derivation.

grammar.definition: qod:ContainerKind->LocativeExpression maps only the3 licensed written compounds to IN(kind). The enclosing case supplies a unique matching written recipient for BODY/RECIPIENT and the input material for FOOD. In a new generic case with a written IN(BODY), the BODY component supplies the generic recipient description. No other qod-looking or ar-ending whole is segmented.
grammar.cost: 1 shared component value;3 cuts;1 type-directed owner-resolution rule with explicit recipient/input roles. Different container kinds cannot be swapped.

grammar.definition: YIELD Y IN(BODY) BY KIND_CHANGE FROM PREVIOUS CONSTITUENT FOOD binds z as a pre-event constituent of the current written input x, and asserts Lineage(z,y,c) plus KindChange(z,y,c). FROM supplies the material-origin relation; PREVIOUS supplies time; CONSTITUENT FOOD supplies part/owner. Every required endpoint is introduced by one of these written phrases. Neither z=y nor Kind(z,not-kind(y)) is inferred.
grammar.cost: 1 ordered provenance construction;1 constituent-food genitive production;2 relations Lineage/KindChange; no claim all release is refuted.

grammar.definition: chey retains a general origin/source relation. SOURCE(condition,cause) and SOURCE(output,precursor) are distinct typed applications, declared in advance; the latter is a lineage and the former is not physical material transfer.
grammar.cost: 2 type cases for1 lexical source relation; no universal chemistry inference.

grammar.definition: SUPPOSE EXISTS K PART BEFOREHAND NO_KIND_CHANGE IN(FOOD) PRECURSOR_OF OUTPUT THIS expands into the separately supplied existential, PartAt, Kind, time, Lineage and NoKindChange claims. The same food-case schema c/x/t0 is shared by these parts. It is a hypothetical schema for relevant food cases, not an asserted constituent inventory.
grammar.cost: 1 ordered hypothesis construction; existential z/y and case-schema roles explicitly introduced; a generic schema closure is an added quantificational assumption.

grammar.definition: THIS Kind identifies the already written discourse kind. OUTPUT THIS in the open hypothesis anticipates the first explicitly named Product output in that same hypothesis consequent, with the same case parameter. No other arbitrary forward or remote reference is allowed. The reference is per generic case, not one physical output shared by everyone.
grammar.cost: 1 typed demonstrative rule plus1 narrow forward-reference rule.

grammar.definition: MaterialKind BODY EVERY frames recipient quantification; the resumed MaterialKind FOOD marks its use as case input. UNIFORMLY applies to the complete result signature of these food cases, independently of the positive BILE product assertion. The bridge is attributed within the counterfactual; it is stronger than mere ubiquitous presence of bile and is an openly costed interpretation.
grammar.cost: 1 fronted universal case frame;1 written-topic resumption;1 result-invariance assertion. No exclusivity or equal composition follows.

grammar.definition: BITTER_FOOD THAT_PRODUCT LIKEWISE FORMS IN(BODY) opens fresh generic cases for food kinds satisfying Bitter(k), reusing the preceding written product KIND. Body/container is supplied by IN(BODY). LIKEWISE copies no physical portion, output token or patient; the existing CF frame persists.
grammar.cost: 1 class-input lifting and1 product-kind anaphor rule; generic-class quantification explicitly counted.

grammar.definition: BUT RECIPIENT FORMS DIFFERENT PRODUCTS FoodKind BODY IN_COMPARISON applies the postposed adjunct to the written comparison selected by its food-kind and recipient-sort arguments. FORMS lifts distributively over its two cases; DIFFERENT separately asserts nonidentical result signatures. This is not inferred from positive bile/blood examples.
grammar.cost: 1 plural product lift;1 postposed comparison-link production with3 arguments(proposition,food-kind,recipient-kind). This costly construction is specific in shape, though no locus IDs enter its rule.

grammar.definition: HEATING EXCESSIVE CAUSES SALTY THEN BITTER is a generic food-event law with its event-kind material argument bound by generic closure. THEN orders the two states. SIMILARLY introduces a new explicitly named honey portion as its example, without identifying it with either recipient-case input.
grammar.cost: 1 generic event-law construction;1 ordered state-pair;1 analogy link.

grammar.definition: Subject BECOMES Property applies unchanged to the written honey portion/BITTER and the written argument/CLEAR. It asserts a transition in the supplied property domain; it is not by itself KindChange or a material-production operation.
grammar.cost: 1 reusable transition construction over typed subjects/properties; two actual argument pairs.

grammar.definition: An explicit noun followed by compatible properties receives a zero-copula predication. EXTERNAL_HEAT EXCESSIVE HARMFUL THEREFORE supplies the active earlier honey-portion as harm target; this target-sharing rule is counted, not an unspoken new owner.
grammar.cost: 1 zero-copula rule;1 explicit nearest-portion argument-sharing rule;1 postposed inference marker attachment.

grammar.rule: Cause list and abbreviated product law
grammar.definition: Quality ORIGIN Cause1 ... CauseN uses a maximal run of CauseKind terms. ProductKind ALSO ConditionProfile is a nominal general product law using only the written discourse food-kind; no individual case, exclusive product or clinical benefit is introduced.
grammar.cost: 1 cause-list production and1 abbreviated general-product production(E2 only). The abbreviated production is additional grammar, not proof recovered from a word.

grammar.definition: BITTER AFTER BOILING EXCESSIVE interprets the property as its corresponding state-kind and applies AFTER to the written event. It is not the converse implication that every bitterness diagnoses excessive boiling.
grammar.cost: 1 property-to-state lift and1 typed temporal rule.

grammar.definition: Source FORBID [RecipientProperty IN(RECIPIENT)] FoodKind constructs attributed dietary advice. EXPERIENCE CONFIRMS THIS_CLAIM refers to that complete advice without converting it into an observed outcome.
grammar.cost: 1 advice-clause production;1 previous-claim reference;1 corroboration production.

grammar.definition: ELDERLY BODY BENEFITS FROM_THAT_USE takes the food-use content from the nearest explicit dietary-advice clause, retaining the food kind but neither its recipient profile nor its prohibition. This is a declared event-description extraction, not identity of patients or actual ingestion events.
grammar.cost: 1 food-use-content extraction rule and1 benefit-clause production. Source-coherent but only one demonstrated use; weakly constrained.

grammar.definition: ALSO may adjoin before a clause or a property complement without changing core argument order. Both W5 ALSO occurrences are retained as emphatic additive contributions. ARGUMENT refers to the just-written discourse, and CLEAR is narrator appraisal only.
grammar.cost: 1 additive-placement production with2 attachment positions;1 discourse-object reference. No duplicated event or silent generation theorem.

source_omissions.omitted: Natural sweetness, antecedent heat sufficiency and no-sweeter-on-boiling explanation.

source_omissions.obligation: Added heat useful in insufficiently warm substances but excessive for honey; earlier bitterness than other foods.
source_omissions.omitted: Benefit to other insufficiently warm materials and explicit sooner-than-other-food comparison.

source_omissions.obligation: Warm constitution or prime: bile before blood; cold constitution and life-period: blood.
source_omissions.omitted: Prime-of-life alternative and separate cold-age/cold-constitution conjunction. S2 uses O as the named opposite-circumstance profile, not an invented one-factor precedence rule.

source_omissions.obligation: Hippocrates advises naturally bilious recipients not to take honey.
source_omissions.omitted: The explanatory restatement of their excessive warmth.

source_omissions.obligation: Reported harm/benefit: bilious disease/old age, old/young, bilious/phlegmatic; reason and experience distinguished.
source_omissions.omitted: All-physicians quantifier, named Empiricists, younger/phlegmatic contrasts and separate rational discovery. Advice corroboration and elderly benefit remain attributed, not verified.

source_omissions.obligation: Six warm-body causes; honey gives bile in warm and blood in opposite circumstances.
source_omissions.omitted: No total precedence among simultaneously opposed conditions is supplied.

source_omissions.obligation: Different recipient products used to argue humours arise in body.
source_omissions.omitted: The source rhetorical impossibility formulation. S2 explicitly authors a constituent/lineage KindChange claim for the blood output; source supplies general bodily alteration, not these individuated roles.

source_omissions.obligation: Preformed-only counterfactual, uniform results, bitter food bile, sweet food no bile.
source_omissions.omitted: The zero-bile sweet-food claim, exclusivity of a pure-release theory for all products and the source all-food universal wording are not separately translated. W1 is a generic preformed-bile schema. W2 explicitly strengthens uniformly to whole-result invariance; this is a costly target hypothesis, not logical consequence or guaranteed source wording.

source_omissions.obligation: Other sweet substances readily become bile in the named warm bodies.
source_omissions.omitted: Entire other-sweet-food extension. W3 is the different hypothetical BITTER-food prediction and must not be counted as this sweet-food obligation.

source_omissions.obligation: Digression acknowledged; Aristotle/Praxagoras credited as expounding Hippocrates/Plato.
source_omissions.omitted: Entire digression and four-author attribution. W5 general argument appraisal is not an alias for those names or statements.

rival.positive_case_setup: Keep both written honey-kind cases, distinct body recipients, positive bile/blood product statements and separately asserted D. Portions may be distinct; common kind imposes no same dose/composition.
rival.selective_release_countermodel: For illustration only, stipulate both input portions contain bile-kind and blood-kind constituents; a single recipient-dependent selector releases bile in W and blood in O without kind change. This extra invented stock plus selection rule fits the positive outcomes and D. Neither stock nor chemical claim is historical evidence.
rival.uniformity_bridge: P is the generic preformed-bile assumption, U is the separately written recipient-invariant result bridge, D is the independently asserted contrast. P plus U yields not-D only with that bridge. D contradicts the conjunction; it cannot eliminate P or selective release by itself. A historically asserted invalid inference may still be the text content.
rival.actual_provenance_discriminator: S2 explicitly ties one zC in input xC to output yC in case cC and asserts KindChange(zC,yC,cC). A pure-release claim of NoKindChange on THAT SAME written lineage cannot also hold. Moving the rival to another precursor would change the compared provenance assertion. A pre-existing blood constituent elsewhere is not a contradiction.
rival.mixed_account: W1 concerns hypothetical bile provenance; S2 concerns an asserted blood lineage. They are not the same output. Preformed bile release plus changed blood remains a coherent mixed account. No claim that all bile must be newly generated or that no preformed constituent exists is written.
rival.epistemic_limit: Because every lexical/grammatical binding is newly authored from known inputs, the discriminator is a consequence of this hypothesis, not confirmation of generation or the target reading.

execution: No decoder or semantic executor. This script only assembled hand-written values/clauses and checked literal occurrence coverage.

construction_reuse_receipt.constraint: Same component/value/type; changing suffix changes container requirement. IT S.16 qodain cannot retain IN_BODY.
Positive production is neither benefit nor preformation nor exclusive output. Input/output roles cannot be exchanged to repair a context.
Same transition relation. A material/state transition and an epistemic appraisal have different typed arguments; neither automatically asserts material lineage.
